items.title: I do not want players to try in an All-Star game. It is not important to me who wins a high-profile pickup game. There is no fanbase for an All-Star team.
items.author: Tony East
items.body_excerpt:
I do not want players to try in an All-Star game. It is not important to me who wins a high-profile pickup game. There is no fanbase for an All-Star team.

A player getting hurt materially impacts the regular season, which has stakes and fans. I would prefer that not be impacted.

July 26, 1992: Charles Barkley received a technical for elbowing Angola's Herlander Coimbra during the Dream Team's first game in Barcelona.

The resulting FT was Angola's only point in a 46-1 scoring run by the U.S.

Barkley later discussed the incident with NBC's Bob Costas.
